title: Version rigid contact quality profiles
requires: Slang CPU and at least one physical GPU driver on one clean revision
scope: Turn the existing independent rigid penetration and rigid attachment checks into immutable vendor-neutral analytic profiles and bind them to the advertised same-domain rigid contact and attachment capabilities.
acceptance: Publish separate versioned contact and attachment profiles with canonical inputs, physical units, unchanged thresholds and independent oracles that do not use driver-private state.
Run both profiles through the public API on Slang CPU and at least one physical GPU driver; retain every failure rather than qualifying from cross-driver agreement.
Update capability obligations and revisioned evidence so each rigid capability qualifies only when its own analytic, lifecycle and reference obligations pass.
